newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stock market bullish on new bank listing.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stock market bullish on new bank listing.

text.p: Zimbabwe's main industrial share index jumped 116.57 points to 10,691.89 on Monday, boosted by strong demand across the board, including in newly-listed National Merchant Bank.

Brokers said they expected the market to remain bullish this week on high liquidity and on interest that has been generated by NMB which was listed on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE) last Thursday and opened trade at over 900 cents its flotation price.

NMB rose 100 cents to 3,400 and some 334,400 shares changed hands on Monday, the second largest number of shares traded on the exchange on the day after textilers KCI in which 382,200 shares were traded unchanged at 120 cents a share.
"NMB has pumped up huge interest in the market and demand is running high across the board," one broker commented.
"There is quite a sizeable amount of money floating around and we are expecting this interest to be sustained at least up to the end of the week," he added.
The ZSE's secondary seven-share mining index edged up 2.38 points to 1,027.70 after a 10-cent rise in coal mining giant Wankie to 570.
